title: Integer and locally constant tensor powers of an invertible module
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $A$ an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module with its dual $A^\vee$ [def-sc-invertible-module]. For $m\in\mathbf Z$, define $A^{\otimes m}$ by the existing integer tensor-power construction with inverse $A^\vee$ and evaluation $A\otimes A^\vee\cong\mathcal O_X$: for $m\geq0$ it is the $m$-fold tensor power of $A$, and for $m<0$ the $(-m)$-fold tensor power of $A^\vee$. For a locally constant function $d:|X|\to\mathbf Z$, let $X_m=d^{-1}(m)$, with open inclusion $j_m:X_m\hookrightarrow X$. Define the variable twist $A^{\otimes d}$ to be the concrete gluing $\prod_{m\in\mathbf Z}(j_m)_*j_m^*(A^{\otimes m})$ in $\mathcal O_X$-modules, with pullback as in [def-pc-module-pullback]. The strata are disjoint and cover $X$; this product has sections on an open $U$ equal to the product of the sections of $A^{\otimes m}$ on $U\cap X_m$.
